nodes.name: App.css
nodes.summary: Styles the starter interface, including its counter, hero artwork, documentation links, and responsive next-step layout.

nodes.name: _apt2.txt
nodes.summary: Supplementary plain-text activity data used as a frontend reference; individual entries and values are intentionally omitted.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Defines the frontend's global EOC design system, including shared theme tokens, typography, surfaces, and application-wide styling for dark and light modes.

nodes.name: missing.txt
nodes.summary: A short Arabic-language reference list of activity categories and aggregate counts; specific entries are not reproduced here.

nodes.name: mobile.css
nodes.summary: Applies mobile-only layout overrides below 768px to reduce horizontal overflow and adapt tables, cards, and section spacing for narrow screens.

nodes.name: supercharged-tail.css
nodes.summary: Provides final cascade overrides for notification, emergency, update, and login-gate visuals, replacing costly continuous effects with lighter animation behavior.

nodes.name: supercharged.css
nodes.summary: Defines an EOC visual and performance layer with shared surface tokens and restrained animation rules, intended to precede mobile-specific overrides.
